image_description: A close-up underwater photograph of a Rock Beauty angelfish (Holocanthus tricolor) against a dark background. The fish displays the characteristic black anterior body and head, transitioning to a bright yellow posterior body and tail. A secondary, smaller, darker fish is partially visible behind the main subject's head.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Small protrusible mouth with brush-like teeth.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The mouth is visible but appears blunt and lacks the distinct small, protrusible structure typical of the species; 'brush-like teeth' are not resolvable at this resolution.
The eye is prominent, large relative to the head, and clearly defined with a blue iris ring.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Laterally compressed disc-shaped body with compact proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The body shape is distinctly laterally compressed and high-backed, matching the disc-shaped profile of an angelfish.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Striking gold and black coloration: anterior body and head black, posterior body and tail golden yellow with black margin.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The color pattern matches the taxonomy perfectly: black front half, yellow back half, with a thin black margin on the tail and dorsal/anal fins.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Continuous dorsal fin with spiny anterior and soft-rayed posterior portions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The dorsal fin is continuous from head to tail, showing the transition from spiny rays near the head to softer rays towards the tail.
The anal fin mirrors the dorsal fin's structure and coloration (yellow with black edge).
The caudal fin is rounded, consistent with the species description.

artifact_observations.location: Behind the main fish's head/gill area
artifact_observations.reasoning: There is a ghostly, semi-transparent second fish head fused into the background behind the main subject's eye. It looks like a reflection or a generation artifact where two instances were merged poorly.

artifact_observations.location: Black scales on the anterior body
artifact_observations.reasoning: The scale pattern on the black portion is extremely uniform and repetitive, lacking the natural micro-variation seen in real macro photography, suggesting a procedural texture or AI smoothing.
